The tallest is Bruno Caboclo at 208 cm. The youngest is Jacob Toppin (born 2000) and the most experienced Tomas Satoransky (born 1991). Beyond Israel, the squad draws most on USA (6), Azerbaijan (1) and Brazil (1). Bar Timor, Bruno Caboclo and Tomer Ginat are back for another spell at the club.
